title: Finite-Shot Operating Windows for Virtual Distillation and Symmetry Verification
summary: Quantum error mitigation methods are usually compared by their infinite-shot bias, yet in an experiment the comparison is decided by a finite shot budget, by the instability of the estimator, and by the cost of each shot. We derive finite-shot mean-squared-error laws for virtual distillation (VD) and symmetry verification (SV) whose leading terms predict when one method overtakes the other and whose remainders are bounded with explicit constants.
